text: Suppose the company that wrote heeyID closes its doors tonight.
prefix: Suppose the company that wrote heeyID closes its doors tonight.

text: Its office is dark, and its servers are off.
prefix: Its office is dark, and its servers are off.

text: Tomorrow at eight, Aziz opens the mobile bank and logs in.
prefix: Tomorrow at eight, Aziz opens the mobile bank and logs in.

text: Does it work?
prefix: Does it work?

text: Lessons one and two followed Aziz on his journey, and gave the map and the words for it.
prefix: Lessons one and two followed Aziz on his journey, and gave the map and the words for it.

text: This lesson shows where all of that runs.
prefix: This lesson shows where all of that runs.

text: The answer is yes, and that answer is the whole design.
prefix: The answer is yes, and that answer is the whole design.

text: heeyID runs inside the perimeter of the bank.
prefix: heeyID runs inside the perimeter of the bank.

text: The bank installs it on its own servers, and the bank operates it.
prefix: The bank installs it on its own servers, and the bank operates it.

text: That copy is called an installation, and one installation serves one bank.
prefix: That copy is called an installation, and one installation serves one bank.

text: A second bank gets a second installation, on its own servers.
prefix: A second bank gets a second installation, on its own servers.

text: Nothing in the installation calls the vendor.
prefix: Nothing in the installation calls the vendor.

text: There is no switch at the vendor that turns it off, and no data goes home.
prefix: There is no switch at the vendor that turns it off, and no data goes home.

text: So the dark office changes nothing for Aziz.
prefix: So the dark office changes nothing for Aziz.

text: This is the most useful promise a vendor can give a bank: at night, the vendor is not needed.
prefix: This is the most useful promise a vendor can give a bank: at night, the vendor is not needed.

text: The personal data stays in the bank, in the Republic of Uzbekistan.
prefix: The personal data stays in the bank, in the Republic of Uzbekistan.

text: Now look at the edge of the perimeter.
prefix: Now look at the edge of the perimeter.

text: Every call that goes out passes one gate, the egress proxy.
prefix: Every call that goes out passes one gate, the egress proxy.

text: The proxy lets out only the host names in the configuration of the installation.
prefix: The proxy lets out only the host names in the configuration of the installation.

text: The list has three names, and all three are outside the bank.
prefix: The list has three names, and all three are outside the bank.

text: The first is MyID, which checks Aziz's face and passport.
prefix: The first is MyID, which checks Aziz's face and passport.

text: Only the MyID adapter calls it, with a credential from the key store of the bank.
prefix: Only the MyID adapter calls it, with a credential from the key store of the bank.

text: The second is the SMS vendor, which sends the text messages.
prefix: The second is the SMS vendor, which sends the text messages.

text: It sends its delivery reports back through the edge, to one address of the SMS adapter.
prefix: It sends its delivery reports back through the edge, to one address of the SMS adapter.

text: The third is the push service, which wakes up the app on Aziz's phone.
prefix: The third is the push service, which wakes up the app on Aziz's phone.

text: Because it is outside, a push carries only the type of the message and a reference.
prefix: Because it is outside, a push carries only the type of the message and a reference.

text: The app then gets the text from heeyID, over its own session.
prefix: The app then gets the text from heeyID, over its own session.

text: TAF is missing from that list.
prefix: TAF is missing from that list.

text: Its agent already runs inside the bank network, and the TAF adapter calls only that agent.
prefix: Its agent already runs inside the bank network, and the TAF adapter calls only that agent.

text: Nobody installs anything for it.
prefix: Nobody installs anything for it.

text: That is the whole outside world of heeyID: three names, through one gate.
prefix: That is the whole outside world of heeyID: three names, through one gate.

text: Inside the installation, there are three networks, one behind the other.
prefix: Inside the installation, there are three networks, one behind the other.

text: First comes the edge, where all traffic enters.
prefix: First comes the edge, where all traffic enters.

text: Then the application network, with the two gateways, Keycloak, the workers and the four adapters.
prefix: Then the application network, with the two gateways, Keycloak, the workers and the four adapters.

text: Then the data network, with Postgres, Valkey, Kafka and Vault.
prefix: Then the data network, with Postgres, Valkey, Kafka and Vault.

text: The edge has no connection to the data network.
prefix: The edge has no connection to the data network.

text: A request must pass a gateway first.
prefix: A request must pass a gateway first.

text: The bank also has two zones of its own: a test zone and a production zone.
prefix: The bank also has two zones of its own: a test zone and a production zone.

text: heeyID runs in both: stage in the test zone, and production in the production zone.
prefix: heeyID runs in both: stage in the test zone, and production in the production zone.

text: In each zone, one Linux host runs the same units with Docker Compose.
prefix: In each zone, one Linux host runs the same units with Docker Compose.

text: There is no network route between the two zones.
prefix: There is no network route between the two zones.

text: Stage talks only to the MyID test service, with test identities.
prefix: Stage talks only to the MyID test service, with test identities.

text: Production talks to the real MyID, with its own credential.
prefix: Production talks to the real MyID, with its own credential.

text: Only configuration moves from stage to production, and a second person approves the move.
prefix: Only configuration moves from stage to production, and a second person approves the move.

text: No database content moves.
prefix: No database content moves.

text: And there is a guard at start-up.
prefix: And there is a guard at start-up.

text: A production build refuses to start when its MyID host is a test host, or when test customers are allowed.
prefix: A production build refuses to start when its MyID host is a test host, or when test customers are allowed.

text: Back to Aziz at eight in the morning.
prefix: Back to Aziz at eight in the morning.

text: His login goes to the edge of his bank, then to the customer gateway, then to the records and the counters.
prefix: His login goes to the edge of his bank, then to the customer gateway, then to the records and the counters.

text: His code comes through the TAF agent, inside the bank.
prefix: His code comes through the TAF agent, inside the bank.

text: Nothing on that path touches the vendor, so the dark office does not matter.
prefix: Nothing on that path touches the vendor, so the dark office does not matter.

text: Now a check: the push service is outside the bank, so what may a push to Aziz's phone carry?
prefix: Now a check: the push service is outside the bank, so what may a push to Aziz's phone carry?

text: Only the type of the message and a reference, never his personal data.
prefix: Only the type of the message and a reference, never his personal data.

text: One installation for one bank, inside its perimeter, operated by the bank.
prefix: One installation for one bank, inside its perimeter, operated by the bank.

text: No call to the vendor.
prefix: No call to the vendor.

text: Three names outside, through the egress proxy: MyID, the SMS vendor and the push service.
prefix: Three names outside, through the egress proxy: MyID, the SMS vendor and the push service.

text: Two zones, and the same units in each.
prefix: Two zones, and the same units in each.

text: Every installation starts from its configuration, and the MyID host is only one value in it.
prefix: Every installation starts from its configuration, and the MyID host is only one value in it.

text: Lesson 4 shows that configuration, and why a missing value stops the start.
